definitions.gloss: economy size, economical, bargain, good value
definitions.explanation: Describes products sold in larger quantities at a lower per-unit price. Used for consumer goods like food, household supplies, and everyday items. Often written as お{徳用|とくよう}.

examples.japanese: お{徳用|とくよう}パックを{買|か}った。
{徳用|とくよう}サイズの{洗剤|せんざい}はお{得|とく}だ。
examples.english: Economy-size detergent is a good deal.

examples.japanese: お{徳用|とくよう}{海苔|のり}は{量|りょう}が{多|おお}くて{家族|かぞく}で{使|つか}うのに{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: The economy-size seaweed has a lot of quantity and is convenient for family use.

notes:
{徳用|とくよう} means economy-size or good value. It is very commonly seen on product packaging as お{徳用|とくよう}, with the polite prefix お.

NOTE ON KANJI:
Also written as {得用|とくよう} using the kanji for 'gain/profit.' Both {徳|とく} and {得|とく} are used, though {徳用|とくよう} is the traditional form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- お{徳用|とくよう}パック: economy pack
- お{徳用|とくよう}サイズ: economy size
- {徳用|とくよう}{袋|ぶくろ}: bargain bag

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- お{得|とく}: bargain, good deal (more casual)
- {大容量|だいようりょう}: large capacity
- {業務用|ぎょうむよう}: commercial/bulk size
